name: session_get
description:
Fetch the actual content of a session — its messages, tool calls, or specific steps. Designed to work hand-in-hand with session_analyze: first call session_analyze to see the structure of a session and the index/refs of every step, then call session_get with precise filters to pull only the content you need.

Filtering is modular and composable. You can fetch:
  - the whole conversation (no filters)
  - specific steps by index (`step_indices` from session_analyze)
  - specific messages (`message_ids`)
  - specific tool calls (`call_ids`)
  - all calls of one or more tools (`tool_names`, e.g. ["webfetch", "read"])

For tool calls you can additionally restrict what is returned with `tool_data`: "input" (only the arguments the tool was called with), "output" (only the result), or "both" (default).

Messages are returned in chronological order in the same format the agent itself sees them (AI SDK ModelMessage). When filtering by tool, a flat array of tool calls is returned instead, each tagged with its step index and call ID so it can be cross-referenced with session_analyze.

session_id.description: ID of the session to retrieve

step_indices.description: Specific step indices to retrieve (as returned by session_analyze.chain[].step). When set, only these steps are returned.

message_ids.description: Specific message IDs to retrieve. When set, only these messages are returned.

call_ids.description: Specific tool call IDs to retrieve. When set, returns a flat list of just those tool calls.

tool_names.description: Filter to only tool calls whose tool name matches one of these (e.g. ["webfetch", "read"]). Returns a flat list of matching tool calls.

tool_data.description: When returning tool calls, controls which fields are included. "input" = arguments only, "output" = result only, "both" = full tool call.

message_limit.description: When fetching the full conversation (no filters), return only the most recent N messages.

include_thinking.description: Include reasoning/thinking blocks in returned messages.

include_tool_calls.description: Include tool call parts in returned messages. Set false for a text-only conversation transcript.

model.description: Optional model context used to format messages. Some providers (Anthropic, OpenAI, Google) support media in tool results — pass the model the agent uses if you need exact parity. If omitted, a generic default is used.
